answer: Issue single-use admission tickets from the public randomness beacon: each epoch the beacon publishes a small batch of cipher puzzles, each bound to one registered keypair and expiring before the epoch ends. To earn, an agent must open its own ticket and post a bond at the vertex where its work is recorded. Tickets cannot be transferred or stockpiled, so a Sybil operator wanting a thousand fake identities must hold a thousand distinct keys, solve a thousand puzzles inside one short window, and lock a thousand bonds, while an honest agent pays for one ticket only.
